messages.content: Predict a respondent’s subjective answer in an English-language online research pilot. They see a surname for a hypothetical person and judge which of two questionnaire groups that person probably belongs to: the general caste group, or the combined group of Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST) and Other Backward Classes (OBC). The second group is called the lower/backward caste group in the study. Predict the respondent’s category choice. Return only general_caste_group or SC_ST_OBC_group.

The respondent was recruited via Mturk for this Indian-sample survey. The displayed surname is Iyer. No individual age, gender, caste, religion, or other surname judgments are supplied. Which of the two groups does the respondent select?
SC_ST_OBC_group
